title: Sale points and documents for commercial movement
rule: Produce may only be shown for sale in registered yards, stores, sites or selling centres. Moving produce commercially needs five documents.
points: Licence to fell and collect forest produce.
A buyer from an allocation holder must obtain copies of the certificate, licence, dealer registration and receipt, and the original transit pass.
penalty: Sale in an unregistered place: fine of TSh 5,000,000 to 10,000,000, or 6 months to 2 years in prison, plus confiscation. Moving without the documents: fine of TSh 5,000,000 to 10,000,000, or 3 to 5 years in prison.
